description: The agent introduces a type error in src/bad.ts; the typescript language server reports it via lsp_diagnostics. Requires typescript-language-server on PATH (workflow prerequisite, pinned to the registry).
prompt: In src/bad.ts, change the initializer of x to the string "not a number" (keep the number type annotation), using the edit tool. Then call lsp_diagnostics on src/bad.ts and reply quoting the full diagnostic line for the error. This run is headless: never call the question tool. Make independent tool calls in the same block.
